# Where to find Gold Junk in Fallout 76

- Duchess Flame![Writer: Duchess Flame]()
- Apr 24, 2025
- 29 min read

Updated: May 7, 2025

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_6b96f16c3c034a6ebad42e0926cad5e2~mv2.jpg)

Image Credit:

__Used for:__

Challenges

- Daily - Scrap Junk to produce Gold
- Weekly - Scrap Junk to produce Gold
- Possum: Miner - Build a Mineral Extractor - Gold in a Workshop or Camp
- Possum: Miner - Take a camera picture of a Gold Deposit

Weapons, Mods, and Skins

- Tesla Rifle Charging Shotgun Barrel
- Paddle Ball Electric Mod
- 50 Cal Machine Gun Gold Paint

Underarmour

- Vault Tec University Jumpsuit
- Vault 33/51/76/94 Jumpsuit

Camp Items

- Goldies Award - Small
- Goldies Award - Large

__Farming Tips and Tricks__

Junk items that contain gold are affected by the per-server pickup history system. This means once you pick them up, they won’t respawn on that server until it resets. If you’re not familiar with how this system works, you can refer to the detailed guide linked [here].

Unfortunately, no perk cards or magazines increase the yield of gold. It is a one-for-one farm, and there's no way to boost the amount you receive from junk items containing gold.

It’s important to avoid using explosive weapons when farming gold scrap, as they can cause junk items to move or become difficult to find. If you lose track of an item, fast travel to a nearby location—any adjacent map icon will do—and then return. This will usually reset the cell and place the junk items back in their original spawn positions.

In cases where a junk item is glitched, and you can’t get close enough to interact with it, you can use explosives or grenades to physically move it. This can help reposition the item so that it becomes accessible.

Note that Super Duper does not apply when converting scrap into bulk. The outcome is always one-to-one, and you will not receive any bonus materials.

To help locate junk that contains components like gold, use the “Tag for Search” feature in your Pip-Boy.

To do this, open your Pip-Boy and navigate to the "Item" tab, then go to "Junk."

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_f9ef7823107b4d37b558aca08050a8e2~mv2.jpg)

From there, access the component view.

On Xbox, press the Right Bumper (RB); on PlayStation, press the right joystick (R3); and on PC, press the “C” key.

This will switch to the component breakdown view of your junk inventory.

Scroll through the list until you find the component you're farming—such as gold—and press the appropriate button (typically “A” or your platform’s equivalent) to tag it for search. This will cause a magnifying glass icon to appear next to relevant items in the world, making them easier to identify and collect.

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_31b11a3899fa49508f5af9a3fb93ebae~mv2.jpg)

If the component you’re searching for doesn’t appear in your component list, it means you haven’t yet collected a piece of junk that contains it. Find and pick up at least one item with the desired component, and then repeat the steps above to tag it.

__Junk items__

When scrapped, yields Gold scrap.

**Arthur Wood's Lighter**

Gives 1 Gold Scrap

**Gold Fork**

Gives 1 Gold Scrap

**Gold Plated Flip Lighter**

Gives 1 Gold Scrap

**Gold Pocket Watch**

Gives 1 Gold Scrap

**Gold Table Knife**

Gives 1 Gold Scrap

**Gold Table Spoon**

Gives 1 Gold Scrap

**Grey & Gould Lighter**

Gives 2 Gold Scrap

**High INT Rock**

Gives 2 Gold Scrap

**Red Star Pin**

Gives 1 Gold Scrap

**Unstoppables! Board Game**

Gives 1 Gold Scrap

**Gold Ore**

Gives 2 Gold Scrap

**Bulk Gold**

Gives 10 Gold Scrap

A list of vendors that sell Bulk Gold can be found in this guide here.

 __Fixed Spawn Locations__

**Ash Heap**

- **Camden Park**

1x Gold-Plated Flip Lighter

1x Pack of Cigarettes

From the spawn-in location, follow the road straight past the bus and stop at the Camden Park sign. Turn right and walk toward the bus in front of you. Enter the bus — the Gold Plated Flip Lighter is on the long bench at the end of the bus on your right.

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_55e0f14f3fbe440ba306b926da5bfda7~mv2.jpg)

- **Brim Quarry**

1x Gold-Plated Flip Lighter

1x Box of San Francisco Sunlights

1x Cigarette Carton

1x Locked Safe

1x Cigarette Machine

From the spawn-in location, go straight through the broken gates and continue following the road all the way to the back, where the shed is. Look for the fusion generator at the back of the shed. Walk over to the generator, face west, and jump up onto the platform. Turn north and enter the shed. Go down the stairs, and the Gold Flip Lighter will be on the top metal shelf on your left.

**Note:** You may need to fast travel away and come back so the cell resets, as there is a reckless Mole Miner with a missile launcher in the shed—and he likes to blow things up and move spawns.

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_417cfdc9e90f4a178b47b5c0c3ca3a13~mv2.jpg)

- **Red Rocket Filling Station**

1x Gold-Plated Flip Lighter

From the spawn-in location, turn and face north. Run forward, jumping over the burnt-out van and any other junk or hills in your path. Continue heading north until you reach the train tracks. Turn left and follow the train tracks west. As you walk, look to your right—you’ll see a blue crashed plane. Turn and head over to the plane. The Gold Plated Flip Lighter is on a rock at the front of the plane.

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_0627a534c7c948938666b853d41fda27~mv2.jpg)

- **Mount Blair Trainyard**

1x Gold-Plated Glass

From the spawn-in location, face west and run straight. Jump over the truck trailer and continue walking forward until you reach the black car and white car crashed together in the middle of the road. Turn right and look up—you’ll see a set of stairs going up the building. Run over and go up the stairs. At the top, keep following the walkway north and enter the blue metal tunnel. Look at the shelves on the wall to your left as you walk down the tunnel. On the second shelf past the windows, you’ll see the Gold Plated Glass next to some green glasses.

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_5b3bffd507ab4b0eab56b2396430c299~mv2.jpg)

- **Garrahan Estate**

1x Unstoppable Board Game

1x Gold Pocket Watch

1x Gold-Plated Flip Lighter

Multiple plain Lighters and Cigarette packets on the balconies and at the bar on the very top floor.

1x Level 2 Locked Door

From the spawn-in location, run straight over to the estate. Enter the building and take the elevator to Garrahan Estate – Top Floor.

Exit the elevator and turn east. There is a set of stairs in front of you—walk behind them instead, and you’ll see a blue door. Unlock and open the blue door and enter the room. The Gold Flip Lighter is on the bedside table to the right of the bed, and the Gold Pocket Watch is on the dresser with the mirror on the right side of the bed.

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_9c63e28ff9e84ac3a9f5fdfd69af0df7~mv2.jpg)

Exit the room and go up the stairs in front of you, then continue up the next set of stairs. Face southwest and head over to the blue door. Open the door, enter the room, and turn west. The Unstoppables board game will be on the shelf on your right.

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_f3dcc2b69dcd46599d29af5298c977bf~mv2.jpg)

- **Hornwright Estate**

1x Gold-Plated Flip Lighter

From the spawn-in location, enter the building and take the elevator. Press the button for Hornwright Estate – Top Floor. Exit the elevator, turn right, and walk up the stairs on your right. At the top of the stairs, walk forward a few steps, then turn left. Walk straight until you reach a coffee table between two red couches. The Gold Plated Flip Lighter will be on the coffee table next to the vase.

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_b70a11b16509402783c78b52743378b5~mv2.jpg)

- **Pleasant Hills Cemetery**

1x Gold Pocket Watch

From the spawn-in location, walk straight toward the wooden path in front of you. Follow the wooden path to the end and stop at the bottom of the stairs. On your left, there is a row of headstones. The Gold Pocket Watch is on top of the second headstone.

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_a353156bf59844e4959fab603b7fa63e~mv2.jpg)

------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

**Forest** 

- **Lady Janet's Soft Serve**
 - Alice in Wonderland Tea Party Scene

1x Unstoppables Board Game

This one’s tough to give directions for—there aren’t many landmarks to guide you. It’s basically “head toward the big tree”… in the middle of a forest.

Your best bet is to place a map marker at the spot shown in my screenshot and just run straight there.

Alternatively, it’s a Nukashine location, so you can also spam Nukashines until you randomly wake up here.

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_d877905177b54755acb6a10e2a287df2~mv2.jpg)

- **Transmission Station 1AT-U03**

1x Gold Scrap

From the spawn-in location, run forward and stop at the wire fence. Face East, jump over the fence, and walk around the outside of the building until you reach the back. You’ll see a hole in the fence and a green porta-potty. Walk over to the porta-potty, open the door, and the Gold Scrap will be inside the toilet.

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_c3e0a5771a1b488eb0560234f504d875~mv2.jpg)

- **Black Mountain Ordnance Works**

1x Gold Pocket Watch

From the spawn-in location, turn slightly Right and follow the road straight until you reach the bunker/office on your Left. Turn and enter the building—the Gold Pocket Watch is on the corner of the desk in the middle of the room, on the Right.

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_79ac6c652bd84172ab5d6378743ba6d4~mv2.jpg)

**The Coop**

1x Gold Pocket Watch

1x Level 0 Terminal

1x Level 2 Safe

From the spawn-in location, look straight ahead, and you’ll see a set of stairs next to a generator, with a building that has a curved roof above it. Walk over, go up the stairs, and enter the building with the curved roof. The Gold Pocket Watch is on the desk, next to the locked terminal and safe.

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_f53b7063174846cc98d1b114df83c5a9~mv2.jpg)

- **Settler's Ridge**

1x Unstoppables Board Game

From the fast travel point, face West and walk forward. Follow the wooden path to walk past the half-built cabins and head towards the completed cabin at the back.

Go down the stairs on your left and walk straight inside the cabin. Keep walking straight and stop at the bottom of the stairs. Turn South and the Unstoppables! Board Game will be on the bookcase on your left.

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_d158f72cff754448906c6f1b1a785f45~mv2.jpg)

- **Twin Pine Cabins**

1x Gold Table Spoon

From the spawn in location, run over to the cabins and stop at the bottom cabin on your right. Turn and enter the cabin and walk towards the dining table at the end. The Gold Table Spoon is at the end of the table on the right.

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_ccce97e6f41142db828a70c34a17f172~mv2.jpg)

1x Gold Table Knife

From the spawn above, exit the cabin and face East. Walk forward, past the tyre wall on your Right, until you reach the dirt road. Follow the dirt road until you reach the main road.

Turn Left, but pay attention—this section forks. You need to follow the main road on the Left-hand side, not the one with the bus on it.

Continue down the road, past the blue car, and stop when you see a skeleton and a bike lying on the road in front of you. The Gold Table Knife is on the ground, above the handlebars and the jar of Junk Royal Jelly.

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_1ee8d224f67646fcb7d69acb463485ec~mv2.jpg)

- **Green Country Lodge**

1x Gold-Plated Flip Lighter

1x Pack of Cigarettes

From the spawn-in location, turn West and walk over to the bus stop. Stand on the path and face Southwest. Walk forward and veer slightly Right so you go through the open doorway between the second motel buildings. Slowly walk forward and turn into the first door on your Left.

The Gold-Plated Flip Lighter is on the middle metal shelf, next to a holotape and a radio.

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_a587ba4d4ac24a559252a69c45eb9348~mv2.jpg)

- **Silva Homestead**

1x Unstoppables Board Game

From the spawn-in location, turn South and follow the road straight until you reach the grey house in the Billings Homestead workshop. Turn Southeast and enter the house. Go upstairs—the Unstoppables Board Game is on the side table opposite the bed, next to a vase and a brush.

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_ed050dfa1bf84642835f5c89393fefc1~mv2.jpg)

- **Summersville Docks**

2x Gold-Plated Flip Lighter

1x Cigar Box

1x Pack of Cigarettes

From the spawn-in location, face South and walk straight. Go down the hill and stop at the bottom—there should be a broken building in front of you. Walk around so the building is at your back and you are facing South.

Now run straight along the dock until you reach a red wooden building. Jump over this building and stop at the red building behind it. The door to the second red wood building is on your Left.

Enter the building and head over to the metal shelves on the West wall. The first lighter is on the metal shelf to the Right, on the second shelf from the bottom. The second lighter is on the corner of the bench, next to the same metal shelf.

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_d470b99f314b47eeb9c72ddbdd008ac0~mv2.jpg)

- **Torrance House**

1x Gold-Plated Flip Lighter

From the spawn-in location, walk forward a few steps, then turn Left into the driveway. Follow the driveway up and stop at the Red Truck on your Right. Jump up onto the truck, walk across the back, and then jump onto the scaffolding. Jump up again onto the balcony, go up the stairs, face South, and jump up onto the roof.

Face Southeast and run straight along the top of the roof until you reach the flat section on the other side. Face North—the Red Comrade Chubs Teddy Bear will be holding the Gold-Plated Flip Lighter.

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_fda1a56d463643958fb8c993f872ed95~mv2.jpg)

- **Overlook Cabin**

1x Gold-Plated Flip Lighter

1x Pack of Cigarettes

1x Level 2 Safe (Basement)

From the spawn-in location, run straight over to the cabin and enter through the front doors. Turn Right and walk forward. Veer slightly Left to stay on the ground floor, and continue walking until you reach the games room with the pool table at the end of the building.

The Gold-Plated Flip Lighter is on the corner of the pool table next to a Pack of Cigarettes.

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_f13cdaee5c424b149e29f2738ed962a7~mv2.jpg)

- **Summersville**

1x Unstoppables Board Game

From the spawn-in location, follow the road straight and stop at the first house on your Right. Turn, but DO NOT enter the house. Walk around to the back and stop at the back door. Face South—the Unstoppables Board Game is on the wooden picnic table on your Right.

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_65b0a7b4be7742d0beb5a9eba0eeded3~mv2.jpg)

- **Tygart Water Treatment**

1x Gold-Plated Flip Lighter

1x Level 0 Terminal

1x Pack of Cigarettes

From the spawn-in location, run straight and veer slightly Right to cross the bridge—then jump the fence (like the outlaw that you are).

Face East, walk through the gate, turn Right, and follow the building until you reach the wire fence. Turn Left and jump up onto the catwalk above you. Turn Left again and enter the building through the blue door in front of you.

Follow the path around and go down the stairs. Stop at the skeleton at the bottom—the Gold-Plated Flip Lighter is on the other side of the skeleton, near the wall.

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_26ba5dee320a4696b5df1f91e2e59237~mv2.jpg)

- **Helveta**

1x Unstoppables Board Game

1x Level 3 Safe (behind the desk in the White Hotel)

From the spawn-in location, follow the road straight. Go past the yellow-colored building and stop at the grey building opposite it. Turn and enter the building, then go up the stairs on your Left. At the top of the stairs, you’ll see a bookcase in front of you. The Unstoppables Board Game is on the bookcase.

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_9e7df292706f4ecea64c778b1436362a~mv2.jpg)

- **Greg's Mine Supply**

1x Gold Scrap

1x Level 1 Safe (upstairs)

1x Level 1 Terminal (upstairs)

Note: If you don't have the key, find the tunnel in the basement of one of the houses on the other side of the street to gain access. The key is on the desk upstairs.

From the spawn-in location, follow the road straight and stop at the first building on your Right. Turn and enter the building via the orange door. Face East and follow the path until you reach the warehouse at the back.

Enter the warehouse and turn Left. Walk forward a few steps—the Gold Scrap will be in the stew pot, in front of the gnome, on top of the wooden crate.

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_8e7b482f986840d5bee56de79fa5d2a1~mv2.jpg)

- **Bolton Green**

1x Unstoppables Board Game

1x Level 2 Safe (behind the front desk)

From the spawn-in location, turn West and run straight until you reach the main road. Face South and run over to the building, entering through the front door.

Stand in the middle of the lobby and face Southeast, then jump up to the floor above you (or take the stairs on your Right). Turn Left and walk forward. Stop at the door on your Left, turn, and go up the stairs.

At the top of the stairs, turn Left and follow the path around to the room at the end. The Unstoppables Board Game is on the wooden shelf by the door, directly in front of you.

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_516d08d7771d4532a4d5bedbf8a8b833~mv2.jpg)

- **Big Al's Tattoo Parlor**

1x Gold-Plated Flip Lighter

1x Carton of Cigarettes

From the spawn-in location, face North, run forward, and jump up onto the roof of the building. Face West and walk toward the air duct on the other side of the roof.

The Gold-Plated Flip Lighter is next to the Imported Chinese Panda Teddy Bear, on the Left side of the duct.

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_a1cefe725c804ea983cf048f0de5c4c1~mv2.jpg)

- **Morgantown**

1x Unstoppables Board Game

1x Level 1 Lock

From the spawn above, jump onto the roof duct and face Northeast. Run forward, jump off the roof, over the fence, then over the hedge and a few more obstacles until you reach the yellow bus. Jump onto the yellow bus and face East. Jump over or walk around until you're standing on the other side of the wire fence.

Face North and walk forward until you reach the building. Turn Right and jump up onto the raised ground above you. Face North again and, keeping the wall on your Left, follow the building around until you reach the fire escape stairs.

Go up the stairs and stop at the very top. Unlock the door on your Right (or just jump over it). The Unstoppables Board Game will be on the air duct in the middle of the area.

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_a25fd5e346c34e0f8a1c45af592f6ada~mv2.jpg)

3x Gold Scrap

4x Safes

1x Cigar Box

Note: Only available during the event Back on the Beat.

This is the third room/stop on the route during the event. Once the Protectron opens the door to the Bank, enter the room and head to the back room on your right.

The Gold Scrap is on the very top shelf in the middle of the South wall. The row of 4 safes is also on the South wall, near the ground.

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_fb95a21e66b0415a9d305722eaa69fce~mv2.jpg)

- **Morgantown Airport**

1x Gold-Plated Flip Lighter

1x Pack of Cigarettes

1x Level 1 Lock (wire gate on the green container next to the red container)

From the spawn-in location, turn Left and walk over to the broken red shipping container gate. Walk through the gate, face East, and run straight—jump over tents, navigate around broken planes and Vertibirds, and pass behind shipping containers.

Stop when you reach the red shipping container next to the yellow digger. Face South and jump over the red shipping container. Turn North and enter the container—the Gold-Plated Flip Lighter is on top of the metal barrel, next to the green lantern.

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_b7a099e0c8e04724b9a0b36fea1a572b~mv2.jpg)

------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

**Toxic Valley**

- **Smith Farm**

1x Unstoppable Board Game

From the spawn-in location, turn to face north. You’ll see a large metal power pylon to your left. Run straight and veer slightly left, heading toward the pylon.

Beneath the pylon, you’ll find a green tent. Inside the tent are two Mr. Fuzzy teddy bears and The Unstoppables Board Game.

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_1a84af174bd24674b12882d17ba25cbd~mv2.jpg)

- **Crater Watchstation**

1x Gold-Plated Flip Lighter

1x Carton of Cigarettes

From the spawn-in location, turn north and run toward the tent—but don’t go inside. Face the tent so you’re looking at the white desks in the center.

On the left side, along the outside wall of the tent, there’s a metal shelf. The Gold-Plated Flip Lighter is tucked behind the Carton of Cigarettes on the top shelf.

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_87ba792a30e14e1fabe9b3bf265d467d~mv2.jpg)

- **Philippi Battlefield Cemetery**

1x Gold Pocket Watch

1x Cigar

1x Level 0 locked First Aid Kit (under the front counter)

2x Stimpaks (on the bookcase upstairs)

From the spawn-in location, turn north and run toward the main building in front of you. Enter through the front door and stop in the lobby, facing north.

Walk straight ahead until you reach the back wall, then turn left and go down the stairs. At the bottom, turn left again and press the red button on the wall—this will open all the display cases.

The Gold Pocket Watch is in the display case right next to the red button you just pressed.

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_52ab6a3d7f224b56970ef8ae1620bfc1~mv2.jpg)

------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

**Savage Divide**

- **Point Repose**

1x Gold-Plated Flip Lighter

From the spawn-in location, face North, run forward, and jump over the gate. In front of you are an open shed and a dome shed. Turn slightly Left and run over to the open shed with the cooking station out front.

At the far Right end of the shed, you'll find two chairs with a chessboard between them on a wooden crate. The Gold-Plated Flip Lighter is on the corner of the crate, next to the chessboard.

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_da9b3eff9b47490386f57d08bb0242e8~mv2.jpg)

- **The Bullengrube**

1x Gold Fork

1x Gold Scrap

From the spawn-in location, face North and run over to the waterfall. Jump up the rocks until you are standing in the middle of the waterfall. Face South, look down, and jump into the water.

Swim straight down until you reach the rocks at the bottom. If you jump into the water at the wrong spot, you might land on a lip—just swim out a little and keep descending until you reach the true bottom. Then, turn West, and you’ll see a cave entrance. Swim forward until you hit the rocks, then swim upward to exit the water and enter the cave.

Once inside the cave, face Southwest and you’ll see a skeleton resting against a chest. The Gold Fork is on the pile of Pre-War Money on the right side of the skeleton, and the 3 Gold Scrap bars are on the Left side of the skeleton.

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_7badfd2bcba04c45b3bcc0032d6a6812~mv2.jpg)

- **Converted Munitions Factory (Bailey Family Cabin)**

1x Gold Pocket Watch

1x Level 2 Locked Door

1x Level 1 Terminal

Fast-travel to Bailey Family Cabin and run over to the Munitions Factory.

Stop when you reach the wire fence and turn North. Walk forward, following the building around while keeping the wall on your Left. Continue until you reach the set of stairs at the back.

Go up the first set of stairs, but do not enter the building. Instead, follow the stairs up to the next blue door. Turn and enter the building through the blue door.

Walk straight ahead to the blue door and terminal on the wall in front of you. Unlock the door—either using the terminal or by lockpicking. Enter the room and face South.

The Gold Pocket Watch is on the metal shelf on the wall, next to the blue can.

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_c7005ce91810427da085b0e222ae87a5~mv2.jpg)

- **Freddy Fear's House of Scares**

1x Unstoppable Board Game

From the spawn-in location, turn North and walk forward behind the building. Follow along the back of the building until you reach the fire escape stairs. Go up the stairs and follow them to the top.

Face West and walk forward a few steps, then open the orange door on your Right. Enter the room—the Unstoppables Board Game will be on the metal shelf directly in front of you.

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_2d3e55aebb3c4feaa28e3643a8e00847~mv2.jpg)

- **Pumpkin House**

1x Gold-Plated Flip Lighter

From the spawn-in location, run straight forward, go up the stairs, and stop on the porch of the house. Turn Right and follow the porch around to the front door.

Enter the house and look for the stairs in the Northwest corner. Go up the stairs and face South. The Gold-Plated Flip Lighter is on the shelf, below the pumpkin poster, next to the bed.

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_8be64251eab645289ffdf13036d593fe~mv2.jpg)

- **Pleasant Valley Cabins**

1x Unstoppable Board Game

From the spawn-in location, turn West and run forward, jumping down to the ground. Turn Southwest and walk forward so you're on the road. Continue following the road past the boat, and keep heading downhill.

Run through the market and stop at the last stall on your Right. Turn West and jump down to the ground. Walk over to the house in front of you and circle around to the back, keeping the wall on your Right.

The Unstoppables Board Game will be on the table on the ground floor, beneath the upper deck.

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_afd6c52e2c744f768a9627fc602c4429~mv2.jpg)

- **New Appalachian Central Trainyard**

1x Gold-Plated Flip Lighter

1x Cigar Box

1x Cigar

From the spawn-in location, run straight over to the building in front of you. Jump up onto the trailer and enter the shed door on your Right. Walk past the container and stop at the flat train bed in front of you.

Veer slightly Right and follow the train bed until you reach the carriage at the end. Turn and enter the carriage. Turn North and walk toward the toilet— the Gold-Plated Flip Lighter is on the wooden crate, next to the candle on your Left.

The Cigar Box and Cigarette are on the table next to the door behind you.

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_88f4244b4f6944b6a72d52c923b6afea~mv2.jpg)

- **National Isolated Radio Array**

1x Unstoppable Board Game

From the spawn-in location, follow the road and stop at the guard house on your Left. Turn Southwest, walk forward, and jump over the gate. Walk toward the main building and enter via the blue door.

Walk forward and stop at the filing cabinet on the ground. Turn North and walk over to the orange chairs and table at the back of the room. Stop at the first table and chairs, then turn West.

The Unstoppables Board Game is on the second table, along with a single telephone.
